key_insights: Meme coin cycle peaked with ETH ETF announcement, focus shifting from Solana to ETH ecosystem
BTC holding steady while altcoins crash - technically a 'bear market' where only altcoins participating
ETH strength historically leads to Bitcoin weakness and broader market weakness due to rotation
Most meme coins likely permanently dead or will struggle for months even if BTC rises

ETF flows having diminishing impact on price - obvious market effects no longer working
Very low market interest and liquidity currently

summary: The meme coin cycle peaked with the ETH ETF announcement, causing a shift from Solana to ETH. BTC remains stable in a range while altcoins crash 50-80%, effectively an altcoin bear market. ETH strength causes Bitcoin and broader market weakness due to rotation. Duck closed most shorts including SOL and WIF after substantial profits. Most meme coins are dead or will struggle for months. Key BTC levels: 62-63k cluster critical support, break targets 52-50k. SOL support at 135 with targets at 100 and potentially 70. Market sentiment has turned very bearish with widespread disillusionment.
